024public class DarkenedGazeSystemScript extends BaseShipSystemScript implements ShroudNegativeParticleFilter {
025        
026        public static float SHIELD_OPENING = 90f;
027        public static float TURN_RATE_REDUCTION = 0.85f;
028        
029        public static float DAMAGE_TAKEN_MULT = 2f;
030        
031        public static String DARKENED_GAZE_SYSTEM_TAG = "darkened_gaze_system_tag";
032        public static String DARKENED_GAZE_PRIMARY_WEAPON_TAG = "darkened_gaze_system_tag";
033        
034        
035        protected List<WeaponAPI> weapons = null; 
036        protected float elapsedActive = 0f; 
037
038        
039        protected void findWeapons(ShipAPI ship) {
040                if (weapons != null) return;
041                
042                ship.addTag(DARKENED_GAZE_SYSTEM_TAG);
043                
044                weapons = new ArrayList<>();
045                int index = 0;
046                for (WeaponAPI w : ship.getAllWeapons()) {
047                        if (w.getSlot().isDecorative()) {
048//                              if (index == 0 || index == 1 || index == 2 || index == 3) {
049//                                      index++;
050//                                      continue;
051//                              }
052                                //if (index == 8) weapons.clear();
053                                weapons.add(w);
054                                //if (index == 8) break;
055                                //break;
056                        }
057                        index++;
058                }
059                
060                float min = 10000000f;
061                WeaponAPI primary = null;
062                //middle-most weapon is "primary"
063                for (WeaponAPI w : weapons) {
064                        float test = w.getSlot().getLocation().y;
065                        if (test < min) {
066                                min = test;
067                                primary = w;
068                        }
069                }
070                if (primary != null) {
071                        primary.setCustom(DARKENED_GAZE_PRIMARY_WEAPON_TAG);
072                }
073                
074                Collections.sort(weapons, (w1, w2) -> {
075                        return (int) Math.signum(Math.abs(w1.getSlot().getLocation().y) - Math.abs(w2.getSlot().getLocation().y));
076                });
077                
078                // hardcoded to assume 9 beams
079                float incr = 0.15f;
080                float [] offsets = new float [] 
081                                {0f, incr, -incr, 2f * incr, -2f * incr, 3f * incr, -3f * incr, 4f * incr, -4f * incr}; 
082                for (int i = 0; i < weapons.size(); i++) {
083                        WeaponAPI w = weapons.get(i);
084                        w.ensureClonedSpec();
085                        w.getSpec().getHardpointAngleOffsets().clear();
086                        w.getSpec().getHardpointAngleOffsets().add(offsets[i]);
087                        w.getSpec().getTurretAngleOffsets().clear();
088                        w.getSpec().getTurretAngleOffsets().add(offsets[i]);
089                        // so that there's no FF
090                        ((BeamWeaponSpecAPI)w.getSpec()).setCollisionClass(CollisionClass.RAY_FIGHTER);
091                }
092        }
093        
094        public boolean isFFAConcern() {
095                if (weapons.size() == 0) return false;
096                return ((BeamWeaponSpecAPI)weapons.get(0).getSpec()).getCollisionClass() == CollisionClass.RAY;
097        }
098        
099        public float getRange() {
100                if (weapons == null || weapons.isEmpty()) return 0f;
101                return weapons.get(0).getRange();
102        }
103        
104        public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id, State state, float effectLevel) {
105                ShipAPI ship = null;
106                if (stats.getEntity() instanceof ShipAPI) {
107                        ship = (ShipAPI) stats.getEntity();
108                } else {
109                        return;
110                }
111                
112                findWeapons(ship);
113                
114                ShieldAPI shield = ship.getShield();
115                if (shield != null) {
116                        shield.forceFacing(ship.getFacing() + 180f);
117                        if (!ship.getFluxTracker().isOverloadedOrVenting()) {
118                                shield.toggleOn();
119                        }
120                        ship.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.TOGGLE_SHIELD_OR_PHASE_CLOAK);
121                }
122                
123                DwellerShroud shroud = DwellerShroud.getShroudFor(ship);
124                
125                //if (state == State.IN || state == State.ACTIVE || state == State.OUT) {
126                if (state == State.ACTIVE || state == State.OUT) {
127                        ship.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.ACCELERATE);
128//                      ship.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.ACCELERATE_BACKWARDS);
129//                      ship.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.STRAFE_LEFT);
130//                      ship.blockCommandForOneFrame(ShipCommand.STRAFE_RIGHT);
131                        if (ship.getVelocity().length() > ship.getMaxSpeedWithoutBoost() * 0.33f) {
132                                ship.giveCommand(ShipCommand.DECELERATE, null, 0);
133                        }
134                }
135                
136                if (state == State.IN) {
137                        if (shield != null) {
138                                float currOpening = effectLevel * SHIELD_OPENING;
139                                shield.setArc(360f - currOpening);
140                        }
141//                      if (shroud != null && effectLevel < 0.5f) {
142//                              SwarmMember added = shroud.addMember();
143//                              //added.flash();
144//                              float arc = 360f - SHIELD_OPENING;
145//                              float angle = ship.getFacing() + 180f + arc/2f - arc * (float) Math.random();
146//                              added.offset = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
147//                              added.offset.scale(shroud.getParams().maxOffset * 0.7f);
148//                              Vector2f offset = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
149//                              offset.scale(shroud.getParams().maxOffset + 200f + (float) Math.random() * 100f);
150//                              Vector2f.add(ship.getLocation(), offset, added.loc);
151//                      }
152                        
153                } else if (state == State.ACTIVE) {
154                        for (WeaponAPI w : weapons) {
155                                //if ((float) Math.random() > 0.97f) {
156                                        w.setForceFireOneFrame(true);
157                                //}
158                        }
159                } else if (state == State.OUT) {
160                        if (shield != null) {
161                                float currOpening = effectLevel * SHIELD_OPENING;
162                                shield.setArc(360f - currOpening);
163                        }       
164                }
165                
166                if (state == State.IN || state == State.ACTIVE) {
167                        if (shroud != null) {
168                                shroud.getShroudParams().negativeParticleClearCenterAreaRadius = 150f; 
169                                shroud.getShroudParams().negativeParticleGenRate = 0.5f;
170                                //shroud.getShroudParams().negativeParticleColorOverride = new Color(0,0,0,255);
171                                shroud.getShroudParams().negativeParticleFilter = this;
172                        }
173                        
174                        
175                        Vector2f dir = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(ship.getFacing() + 180f);
176                        float amount = Global.getCombatEngine().getElapsedInLastFrame();
177                        
178                        
179                        float accel = ConvulsiveLungeSystemScript.PARTICLE_WINDUP_ACCEL * amount * effectLevel;
180                        if (shroud != null) {
181                                for (SwarmMember p : shroud.getMembers()) {
182                                        float currAngle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(ship.getLocation(), p.loc);
183                                        float angleDiff = Misc.getAngleDiff(currAngle, ship.getFacing());
184                                        float accelMult = 1f;
185                                        if (angleDiff > SHIELD_OPENING * 0.5f) {
186                                                //accelMult = SHIELD_OPENING * 0.5f / angleDiff;
187                                                accelMult = 0f;
188                                        }
189                                        
190                                        p.vel.x += dir.x * accel * accelMult;
191                                        p.vel.y += dir.y * accel * accelMult;
192                                }
193                        }
194                        if (state == State.ACTIVE) {
195                                elapsedActive += amount;
196                                float f = Math.min(elapsedActive, 1f) * 1f;
197                                f = 1f - f;
198                                //float beamSpeedMult = 1f + (float) Math.sqrt(f) * 2f;
199//                              float beamSpeedMult = 1f + f * f * 2f;
200//                              ship.getMutableStats().getBeamSpeedMod().modifyMult(id, beamSpeedMult);
201                        }
202                        
203                        ship.getMutableStats().getMaxTurnRate().modifyMult(id, 1f - TURN_RATE_REDUCTION * effectLevel);
204                        ship.getMutableStats().getHullDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, 1f + (DAMAGE_TAKEN_MULT - 1f) * effectLevel);
205                } else {
206                        if (shroud != null) {
207                                shroud.getShroudParams().negativeParticleClearCenterAreaRadius = 50f;
208                                shroud.getShroudParams().negativeParticleGenRate = 1f;
209                                //shroud.getShroudParams().negativeParticleColorOverride = null;
210                                shroud.getShroudParams().negativeParticleFilter = null;
211                        }
212                        elapsedActive = 0f;
213                        ship.getMutableStats().getMaxTurnRate().unmodifyMult(id);
214                        ship.getMutableStats().getHullDamageTakenMult().unmodifyMult(id);
215                        //ship.getMutableStats().getBeamSpeedMod().unmodifyMult(id);
216                }
217                
218                ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.BACK_OFF_MIN_RANGE, 1f, getRange() - 300f);
219                
220                if (state == State.IDLE) {
221                        shield.setArc(360f);
222                }
223                        
224        }
225        
226        public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id) {
227        }

230                return null;
231        }

233        @Override
234        public String getInfoText(ShipSystemAPI system, ShipAPI ship) {
235                return super.getInfoText(system, ship);
236        }
237
238        @Override
239        public boolean isParticleOk(DwellerShroud shroud, Vector2f loc) {
240                // only filtering when in/active, not idle/out/cooldown, so don't worry about those cases
241                if (shroud == null || shroud.getAttachedTo() == null) return true;
242                float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(shroud.getAttachedTo().getLocation(), loc);
243                return !Misc.isInArc(shroud.getAttachedTo().getFacing(), SHIELD_OPENING, angle);
244        }
